intro: Moonglow Vest is a trade training task offered by the night elf leatherworker Lotherias in Darnassus. Overwhelmed by the constant needs of young adventurers heading into the wilds of Kalimdor, she trades the knowledge of a specialized night elven tunic pattern in exchange for bulk shipments of embossed leather gear.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We in Darnassus, especially we craftsman, are quite busy. Young adventurers are eager to test themselves in the wilderness, and are in constant need of supplies.
If you can help me fill my orders of leather goods, then perhaps I can teach you an advanced leatherworking technique.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, these are good pieces. You have a skilled hand and an eye for detail. Your future as a leatherworker is promising.
Here, friend. Let me show you the pattern to make the :Moonglow Vest.
